---
title: "AML1010 mitochondrial variants in TCF12 vs TCF12_2 subclones"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(Seurat)
  library(dplyr)
  library(SummarizedExperiment)
  library(GenomicRanges)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(ggrepel)
  library(scales)
  library(qs2)
})

## =========================================================
## Paths
## =========================================================
PROJECT_DIR <- "/path/to/project"
AML1010_DIR <- file.path(PROJECT_DIR, "AML1010")
out_dir     <- file.path(PROJECT_DIR, "AML1010_1026/plots")
dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# helper functions (computeAFMutMatrix) from the MAESTER analysis code
source(file.path(AML1010_DIR, "scripts/210215_FunctionsGeneral.R"))

## =========================================================
## Inputs
##   - Seurat object: AML1010_scrna_preprocessing.R
##   - rhPCR mutation list: extract_mutations_AML1010.R
##   - maegatk output: preprocessing/aml1010_mito/02_maegatk.sh
## =========================================================
obj_1010      <- qs2::qs_read(file.path(AML1010_DIR, "objects/obj_1010_with_BoneMarrowMap_Broad_final.qs2"))
AML1010_rhPCR <- readRDS(file.path(AML1010_DIR, "objects/AML1010_rhPCRonly_mutation_data_list_inSeurat.rds"))
AML1010.1.mito <- readRDS(file.path(AML1010_DIR, "data/mito/maegatk/AML1010.1_mito/final/maegatk.rds"))
AML1010.3.mito <- readRDS(file.path(AML1010_DIR, "data/mito/maegatk/AML1010.3_mito/final/maegatk.rds"))
AML1010.5.mito <- readRDS(file.path(AML1010_DIR, "data/mito/maegatk/AML1010.5_mito/final/maegatk.rds"))
```

```{r mito variant association}
## =========================================================
## SETTINGS
## =========================================================
min_depth             <- 5     # whole-cell average depth floor (initial cell inclusion)
min_pos_depth         <- 5     # PER-POSITION depth required to trust a presence/absence call
present_cutoff         <- 5    # AF% cutoff for "present"
min_cells_with_variant <- 50   # overall prevalence floor (on well-covered cells only)
min_frac_genotyped     <- 0.6  # require >=60% of EACH group to be well-covered at that position
min_abs_delta           <- 0.10 # minimum prevalence difference to report as a candidate

## =========================================================
## 1) Build AF matrix + matching PER-POSITION coverage matrix, per timepoint
## =========================================================
build_af_and_coverage <- function(mito_rse, sample_prefix, min_depth = 5, scale_to_percent = TRUE) {
  af <- data.matrix(computeAFMutMatrix(mito_rse))
  if (scale_to_percent) af <- af * 100
  rownames(af) <- gsub("_", "", rownames(af))

  # whole-cell depth (initial cell filter, same as before)
  depths <- SummarizedExperiment::colData(mito_rse)$depth
  names(depths) <- colnames(mito_rse)
  keep_cells <- intersect(names(depths)[depths >= min_depth], colnames(af))
  af <- af[, keep_cells, drop = FALSE]

  # per-position coverage assay: positions x cells (all 16569 positions)
  cov_assay <- SummarizedExperiment::assay(mito_rse, "coverage")
  gr <- SummarizedExperiment::rowRanges(mito_rse)
  positions_all <- GenomicRanges::start(gr)

  # extract genomic position from each variant name, e.g. "676G>A" -> 676
  variant_positions <- as.numeric(gsub("[^0-9].*$", "", rownames(af)))

  # match each variant's row to its position's coverage row
  pos_row_idx <- match(variant_positions, positions_all)
  stopifnot(all(!is.na(pos_row_idx)))  # sanity check: every variant position found

  cov_mat <- cov_assay[pos_row_idx, keep_cells, drop = FALSE]
  rownames(cov_mat) <- rownames(af)

  colnames(af)      <- paste0(sample_prefix, "_", colnames(af), "-1")
  colnames(cov_mat)  <- paste0(sample_prefix, "_", colnames(cov_mat), "-1")

  list(af = af, cov = cov_mat)
}

res1 <- build_af_and_coverage(AML1010.1.mito, "AML1010.1", min_depth = min_depth)
res3 <- build_af_and_coverage(AML1010.3.mito, "AML1010.3", min_depth = min_depth)
res5 <- build_af_and_coverage(AML1010.5.mito, "AML1010.5", min_depth = min_depth)

## =========================================================
## 2) Merge across timepoints (AF and coverage together, same variants/cells)
## =========================================================
common_vars <- Reduce(intersect, list(rownames(res1$af), rownames(res3$af), rownames(res5$af)))

af_merged  <- cbind(res1$af[common_vars, ,  drop = FALSE],
                     res3$af[common_vars, ,  drop = FALSE],
                     res5$af[common_vars, ,  drop = FALSE])
cov_merged <- cbind(res1$cov[common_vars, , drop = FALSE],
                     res3$cov[common_vars, , drop = FALSE],
                     res5$cov[common_vars, , drop = FALSE])

# restrict to Seurat cells
keep_cols <- colnames(af_merged) %in% colnames(obj_1010)
af_merged  <- af_merged[, keep_cols, drop = FALSE]
cov_merged <- cov_merged[, keep_cols, drop = FALSE]

stopifnot(identical(dim(af_merged), dim(cov_merged)))
rm(res1, res3, res5)

cat("Merged matrices:", nrow(af_merged), "variants x", ncol(af_merged), "cells\n")

## =========================================================
## 3) Build mutually-exclusive TCF12 / TCF12_2 groups (unchanged logic)
## =========================================================
t1 <- AML1010_rhPCR$TCF12
t2 <- AML1010_rhPCR$TCF12_2
cells_in_seurat <- colnames(obj_1010)

collapse_status <- function(df, cells_keep) {
  df %>%
    dplyr::mutate(bc = as.character(bc), mutated = as.character(mutated)) %>%
    dplyr::filter(bc %in% cells_keep) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(bc) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      status = dplyr::case_when(
        any(mutated == "mutated")  ~ "mutated",
        any(mutated == "wildtype") ~ "wildtype",
        TRUE ~ "unknown"
      ), .groups = "drop")
}

t1_map <- collapse_status(t1, cells_in_seurat)
t2_map <- collapse_status(t2, cells_in_seurat)

obj_1010@meta.data$TCF12_1_status <- "unknown"
obj_1010@meta.data$TCF12_2_status <- "unknown"
obj_1010@meta.data[t1_map$bc, "TCF12_1_status"] <- t1_map$status
obj_1010@meta.data[t2_map$bc, "TCF12_2_status"] <- t2_map$status

cells_mut_t1 <- rownames(obj_1010@meta.data)[obj_1010@meta.data$TCF12_1_status == "mutated"]
cells_mut_t2 <- rownames(obj_1010@meta.data)[obj_1010@meta.data$TCF12_2_status == "mutated"]
cells_mut_both <- intersect(cells_mut_t1, cells_mut_t2)

cells_tcf12_only   <- setdiff(cells_mut_t1, cells_mut_both)
cells_tcf12_2_only <- setdiff(cells_mut_t2, cells_mut_both)

mito_cells <- colnames(af_merged)
cells_g1 <- intersect(cells_tcf12_only,   mito_cells)   # TCF12-only
cells_g2 <- intersect(cells_tcf12_2_only, mito_cells)   # TCF12_2-only

cat("TCF12-only (any mito coverage):", length(cells_g1), "\n")
cat("TCF12_2-only (any mito coverage):", length(cells_g2), "\n")

## =========================================================
## 4) Per-variant: use ONLY cells genotyped (coverage >= min_pos_depth) at that position
##    Require both groups to be >= min_frac_genotyped covered, else drop the variant
## =========================================================
af_g1  <- af_merged[,  cells_g1, drop = FALSE]
cov_g1 <- cov_merged[, cells_g1, drop = FALSE]
af_g2  <- af_merged[,  cells_g2, drop = FALSE]
cov_g2 <- cov_merged[, cells_g2, drop = FALSE]

n1_total <- length(cells_g1); n2_total <- length(cells_g2)

genotyped_g1 <- cov_g1 >= min_pos_depth   # variants x cells, logical
genotyped_g2 <- cov_g2 >= min_pos_depth

frac_genotyped_g1 <- rowSums(genotyped_g1) / n1_total
frac_genotyped_g2 <- rowSums(genotyped_g2) / n2_total

well_genotyped <- frac_genotyped_g1 >= min_frac_genotyped &
                  frac_genotyped_g2 >= min_frac_genotyped

cat("\nVariants passing genotyping-completeness filter (>=", min_frac_genotyped*100,
    "% covered in BOTH groups):", sum(well_genotyped), "of", nrow(af_merged), "\n")

af_g1_wg  <- af_g1[well_genotyped, , drop = FALSE]
cov_g1_wg <- cov_g1[well_genotyped, , drop = FALSE]
af_g2_wg  <- af_g2[well_genotyped, , drop = FALSE]
cov_g2_wg <- cov_g2[well_genotyped, , drop = FALSE]

## =========================================================
## 5) Compute presence ONLY among genotyped cells; Fisher's test with per-variant n1/n2
## =========================================================
present_fun <- function(af, cov) (af > present_cutoff) & (cov >= min_pos_depth)
genotyped_fun <- function(cov) cov >= min_pos_depth

a <- rowSums(present_fun(af_g1_wg, cov_g1_wg))         # present, TCF12-only
n1_v <- rowSums(genotyped_fun(cov_g1_wg))               # genotyped, TCF12-only (per-variant n)
b <- n1_v - a

c <- rowSums(present_fun(af_g2_wg, cov_g2_wg))          # present, TCF12_2-only
n2_v <- rowSums(genotyped_fun(cov_g2_wg))                # genotyped, TCF12_2-only (per-variant n)
d <- n2_v - c

frac1 <- a / n1_v
frac2 <- c / n2_v
delta <- frac1 - frac2
eps <- 1e-6
rr_1_over_2 <- (frac1 + eps) / (frac2 + eps)
rr_2_over_1 <- (frac2 + eps) / (frac1 + eps)

pval <- vapply(seq_along(a), function(i) {
  suppressWarnings(fisher.test(matrix(c(a[i], b[i], c[i], d[i]), nrow = 2))$p.value)
}, numeric(1))
padj <- p.adjust(pval, method = "BH")

mito_clone_assoc_robust <- data.frame(
  variant        = rownames(af_g1_wg),
  n1_genotyped   = n1_v,
  n2_genotyped   = n2_v,
  present_TCF12   = a,
  present_TCF12_2 = c,
  frac_TCF12      = frac1,
  frac_TCF12_2    = frac2,
  delta_frac      = delta,
  rr_1_over_2     = rr_1_over_2,
  rr_2_over_1     = rr_2_over_1,
  p_value         = pval,
  p_adj           = padj,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

## =========================================================
## 6) NO threshold-based inclusion filter — just rank by significance
##    (only genotyping-completeness from step 4 is applied upstream)
## =========================================================
ranked_TCF12 <- mito_clone_assoc_robust %>%
  dplyr::filter(delta_frac >= min_abs_delta) %>%   # keep only effect-size direction/magnitude, no presence/leakage caps
  dplyr::arrange(p_adj, p_value)

ranked_TCF12_2 <- mito_clone_assoc_robust %>%
  dplyr::filter(delta_frac <= -min_abs_delta) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(p_adj, p_value)

cat("\n=== Ranked candidates (genotyping-complete, delta >= 0.10, no presence/leakage caps) ===\n")
cat("TCF12-only:", nrow(ranked_TCF12), "\n")
print(head(ranked_TCF12, 20))

cat("\nTCF12_2-only:", nrow(ranked_TCF12_2), "\n")
print(head(ranked_TCF12_2, 20))

## Explicitly flag which ones are BH-significant
cat("\n=== BH-significant (p_adj < 0.05) ===\n")
print(mito_clone_assoc_robust %>% dplyr::filter(p_adj < 0.05) %>% dplyr::arrange(p_adj))
```

```{r volcano adjusted p}
plot_mito_volcano <- function(assoc_df,
                               delta_cutoff = 0.10,
                               padj_cutoff  = 0.05) {

  df <- assoc_df %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      neg_log10_padj = -log10(pmax(p_adj, 1e-300)),
      category = dplyr::case_when(
        p_adj < padj_cutoff & delta_frac >=  delta_cutoff ~ "Significant: TCF12-only",
        p_adj < padj_cutoff & delta_frac <= -delta_cutoff ~ "Significant: TCF12_2-only",
        abs(delta_frac) >= delta_cutoff                    ~ "Candidate (not p_adj-significant)",
        TRUE ~ "NS"
      ),
      category = factor(category, levels = c("Significant: TCF12-only",
                                               "Significant: TCF12_2-only",
                                               "Candidate (not p_adj-significant)",
                                               "NS"))
    )

  # label every candidate/significant variant (|delta| >= cutoff)
  all_labels <- df %>%
    dplyr::filter(category != "NS")

  cat("Labeling", nrow(all_labels), "variants with |delta_frac| >=", delta_cutoff, "\n")

  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = delta_frac, y = neg_log10_padj, color = category)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.7, size = 2) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = c(-delta_cutoff, delta_cutoff), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(padj_cutoff), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40") +
    ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
      data = all_labels,
      aes(label = variant),
      size = 3, max.overlaps = Inf, show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c(
      "Significant: TCF12-only"           = "#D55E00",
      "Significant: TCF12_2-only"         = "#0072B2",
      "Candidate (not p_adj-significant)" = "grey45",
      "NS"                                 = "grey85"
    )) +
    labs(
      x = "Prevalence difference (\u0394frac)",
      y = expression(-log[10](adj.~italic(p)~value))
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
    theme(
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "none"
    )

  return(p)
}

# -----------------------------
# Generate + save
# -----------------------------
p_volcano_robust <- plot_mito_volcano(mito_clone_assoc_robust)
p_volcano_robust


ggsave(
  filename = file.path(out_dir, "mito_volcano_TCF12_vs_TCF12_2_final.pdf"),
  plot     = p_volcano_robust,
  width    = 9,
  height   = 10,
  units    = "cm"
)
```

```{r volcano raw p}
save_png_pdf <- function(prefix, plot, width = 5, height = 6, units = "cm", dpi = 600) {
  ggplot2::ggsave(paste0(prefix, ".png"), plot = plot, width = width, height = height, units = units, dpi = dpi)
  ggplot2::ggsave(paste0(prefix, ".pdf"), plot = plot, width = width, height = height, units = units, device = cairo_pdf)
}

plot_mito_volcano_raw <- function(assoc_df,
                                   delta_cutoff = 0.10,
                                   p_cutoff     = 0.05) {

  df <- assoc_df %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      neg_log10_p = -log10(pmax(p_value, 1e-300)),
      category = dplyr::case_when(
        p_value < p_cutoff & delta_frac >=  delta_cutoff ~ "Raw-p significant: TCF12-only",
        p_value < p_cutoff & delta_frac <= -delta_cutoff ~ "Raw-p significant: TCF12_2-only",
        abs(delta_frac) >= delta_cutoff                   ~ "Candidate (delta only)",
        TRUE ~ "NS"
      ),
      category = factor(category, levels = c("Raw-p significant: TCF12-only",
                                               "Raw-p significant: TCF12_2-only",
                                               "Candidate (delta only)",
                                               "NS"))
    )

  all_labels <- df %>%
    dplyr::filter(category != "NS")

  cat("Labeling", nrow(all_labels), "variants with |delta_frac| >=", delta_cutoff, "\n")

  ymax <- max(df$neg_log10_p, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.1
  y_breaks <- unique(c(0, -log10(p_cutoff), pretty(c(0, ymax))))
  y_breaks <- y_breaks[y_breaks >= 0 & y_breaks <= ymax]

  colors <- c(
    "Raw-p significant: TCF12-only"   = "firebrick",
    "Raw-p significant: TCF12_2-only" = "#0072B2",
    "Candidate (delta only)"           = "grey45",
    "NS"                                = "lightgrey"
  )

  p <- ggplot2::ggplot(df, ggplot2::aes(x = delta_frac, y = neg_log10_p, color = category)) +
    ggplot2::geom_point(size = 0.25, alpha = 0.8, stroke = 0) +
    ggplot2::scale_color_manual(values = colors) +
    ggplot2::geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(p_cutoff), linetype = "dashed", color = "black", linewidth = 0.2, alpha = 0.3) +
    ggplot2::geom_vline(xintercept = c(-delta_cutoff, delta_cutoff), linetype = "dashed", color = "black", linewidth = 0.2, alpha = 0.3) +
    ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = c(-0.3, -0.15, 0, 0.15, 0.3),
      labels = c("-0.3", "-0.15", "0", "0.15", "0.3")
    ) +
    ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(
      limits = c(0, ymax),
      breaks = y_breaks,
      labels = scales::label_number(accuracy = 1),
      expand = c(0, 0)
    ) +
    ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
      data = all_labels,
      ggplot2::aes(label = variant),
      size = 1.4,
      color = "black",
      segment.size = 0.1,
      segment.alpha = 0.5,
      box.padding = 0.05,
      point.padding = 0.05,
      min.segment.length = 0,
      max.overlaps = 40,
      force = 2
    ) +
    ggplot2::labs(
      x = "Prevalence difference (\u0394frac)",
      y = expression(-log[10](italic(p)~value~"(raw)"))
    ) +
    ggplot2::theme_minimal(base_size = 5) +
    ggplot2::theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      axis.title  = ggplot2::element_text(size = 5),
      axis.text   = ggplot2::element_text(size = 4),
      panel.grid  = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      panel.border = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      axis.line   = ggplot2::element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.2),
      axis.ticks  = ggplot2::element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.2),
      axis.ticks.length = unit(0.5, "mm"),
      plot.margin = ggplot2::margin(1, 1, 1, 1, unit = "mm")
    )

  return(p)
}

# -----------------------------
# Generate + save
# -----------------------------
p_volcano_raw <- plot_mito_volcano_raw(mito_clone_assoc_robust)
p_volcano_raw

out_prefix <- file.path(out_dir, "mito_volcano_TCF12_vs_TCF12_2_rawp")

save_png_pdf(out_prefix, p_volcano_raw, width = 5, height = 6)
```
